nodes.speaker: Guard Aldric
text: Greetings, traveler! Welcome to Lumenfall Village.
I am Guard Aldric, protector of this peaceful place.
What brings you here?

choices.label: I want to help the village!

nodes.speaker: Guard Aldric
text: Excellent! We have been troubled by shadows that grow stronger at night.
These dark creatures fear light and fire.
If you can master the light, you may help us defeat the shadows!

choices.label: How do I use light magic?
I will help! Tell me more.

nodes.speaker: Guard Aldric
text: That is fine! Feel free to explore our beautiful village.
When you are ready to learn more, find me here.
Or talk to our wise Apprentice Mira - she knows much about magic!

nodes.speaker: Guard Aldric
text: I am the Guard of this village - I keep the people safe.
My duty is to watch for danger and help travelers like you.
Do you need any assistance?

nodes.speaker: Guard Aldric
text: Visit our Apprentice Mira - she is learning light magic from the village scholar.
She can teach you the basics of channeling light energy.
Return to me when you are ready!

nodes.speaker: Guard Aldric
text: The shadows have been growing bolder. We need help!
First, learn about light magic from Mira.
Then, travel to the forest to the north and investigate.
Be brave, traveler. The village is counting on you!

nodes.speaker: Mira the Apprentice
text: Hello! I am Mira, an apprentice learning magic.
I study light magic with Scholar Vera.
Are you interested in learning about magic too?

choices.label: Yes! Teach me about light magic!

nodes.speaker: Mira the Apprentice
text: Light magic is channeling the power of the sun and stars!
When you focus on light, it pushes away the darkness.
The shadows cannot survive in places filled with bright, warm light.

choices.label: How do I use this power?

nodes.speaker: Mira the Apprentice
text: Light magic is very ancient and powerful!
It comes from the sun, moon, and stars.
We use it to protect our village from the shadows that come at night.

nodes.speaker: Mira the Apprentice
text: It is simple - you must believe in the light!
When you carry a torch or lantern, you create a safe space.
The light keeps the shadows away. Try it when you see darkness!

nodes.speaker: Mira the Apprentice
text: Yes, very dangerous! They come at night when it is darkest.
They are cold and hungry, always seeking light to consume.
But do not be afraid - with light magic, you can defeat them!

nodes.speaker: Mira the Apprentice
text: Scholar Vera lives in the house to the east!
She knows much more than me about magic.
But she is quiet - you must listen carefully to her words.

nodes.speaker: Scholar Vera
text: Welcome. I am Vera, keeper of ancient knowledge.
I study the nature of light and shadows.
What do you wish to know?

choices.label: How can I help the village?

nodes.speaker: Scholar Vera
text: The shadows are ancient beings from the void.
They grow stronger each night, feeding on fear and darkness.
Light is their only weakness. A single torch can drive them back.

choices.label: How do I get a torch?

nodes.speaker: Scholar Vera
text: The village needs someone brave enough to explore the northern forest.
There, you may find the source of the shadow influence.
Bring back knowledge, and you will have helped us all.

choices.label: I will go to the forest!

nodes.speaker: Scholar Vera
text: I am a scholar and teacher. My role is to preserve knowledge.
I study magic to help protect those I care about.
I also mentor young Mira in the ways of light magic.

nodes.speaker: Scholar Vera
text: The blacksmith in our village can craft torches.
Or you may find one already placed in safe locations.
When you hold a torch, the shadows cannot approach you.
